description: Look up a business by its phone number in the Odile Direct directory and get its Direct card. Start here: send_to_business needs the business id (<biz>) from this card. Pass the number as customers dial it, in E.164 with the country code and no spaces or dashes (+15615550123); any other format is rejected. Returns {agent_card, business, trade, town}: agent_card is the A2A card URL (/b/<biz>/ for a business line, /c/<biz>/ for a claimed listing; pass that <biz> to send_to_business), and the card lists the skills the business accepts. A number that is not on Direct returns not_found with claim_url and listings_url; for a US or Canadian number, voice_fallback says whether call_business is available. Capped at 30 lookups per IP per hour without sign-in and 10000 per key per day signed in. Read-only; contacts no business. Example: number='+15615550123' returns the card whose id you pass to send_to_business as biz.

number.description: The business's phone number in E.164, e.g. +15615550123.
